order: Close out every finding from the prior review round. Rewrite the test-authoring seat's mirror-substitution conflict text to match the exception now declared for that seat, closed by the cross-family exception recorded elsewhere, and confirm the lint check exits clean. Restore the documentation seat's dropped rule that the inert verification tier never applies to documentation, reinstating it at its original plan lines. Correct the legacy-validation rule-count table for the base and heavy executors — ten rules for the base, twelve for heavy — adding the two rules unique to heavy that it omitted. Fix the write-up so the environment-variable deviation is described as caught on review rather than self-disclosed, since the report's own deviations line says none. State the cross-vendor engine fault tally as exactly ten of fourteen engine-reaching attempts, with an explicit counting rule and full per-attempt list, replacing the earlier wrong figure. Clear the remaining minor findings and nits still open from the prior round.
claims: We fixed all five major findings and six minor findings from the prior round, plus every outstanding nit, across ten files with a substantial batch of insertions and far fewer deletions. The cross-vendor engine fault tally was recomputed and confirmed as exactly 10 of 14 engine-reaching attempts, with an explicit counting rule and a full per-attempt list replacing the earlier wrong figure of roughly six of fifteen. The rule-count table now reads ten base rules and twelve heavy rules, checked against the source files row by row.
